metadata.description: Meta-skills marketplace for agent-team orchestration, doc generation, system-design explanation, slice shipping, and vault capture

plugins.name: meta-plugin
plugins.description: An agent-team skill for scaffolding and orchestrating adaptive role-based agent teams (explicit invocation or written debate/live-steering justification only — routing per the harness routing guide), a doc-system skill for generating PRD/SPEC/CLAUDE.md, a system-explain skill for first-principles system-design explanations, a ship-slice skill for atomically shipping a vertical slice (status flip in milestone.md, handoff pointer advance, teammate shutdown, one commit), and a vault-save utility for stashing Claude responses into an Obsidian vault
